description: Start here before raw reads: deterministic insights across GSC, audit, indexing and AI-crawler data, each with typed evidence, severity, impact and a suggested next action. The list is ranked and says what could not be checked and why; an empty list means no rule fired, not that the site is healthy. Live GSC is used only when the plan and daily budget allow; otherwise the GSC types are reported as not evaluated and the other sources still return. Read-only. Requires the audit:read scope.

days.description: Comparison window; GSC final data ends ~3 days ago

types.description: Optional subset of insight types; omit for all
